incidents.summary: Community representatives alleged that Pan African Resources used illegal miners as cheaper labour and ignored social and labour commitments, which the company denied.

sources.title: South Africa: Locals allege Pan African Resources employing illegal miners for cheap labour; company comments - Business and Human Rights Centre
sources.quote: Yumba, and Ohentse Ditire who spoke on behalf of West Village residents accuse Pan African Resources of reneging on commitments to draw up a social and labour plan (SLP) that benefits them.

sources.title: South Africa: Locals allege Pan African Resources employing illegal miners for cheap labour; company comments - Business and Human Rights Centre
sources.quote: The private companies are working with the zama zamas because it’s cheaper labour,” Yumba alleged.

sources.title: South Africa: Locals allege Pan African Resources employing illegal miners for cheap labour; company comments - Business and Human Rights Centre
sources.quote: Spokesperson Hethen Hira said they were not working with any illegal miners, and they also had no plans of ever collaborating with them.

positives: Pan African Resources was named the Mining Elites 2026 Water Management Winner.
Evander Mines’ reverse osmosis plant produces 3 ML of drinkable water daily from recycled underground water.
Construction of the Mogale tailings retreatment project employed about 1,600 people, including over 1,000 from the local community.
